tool: Codex GPT Image texture swatch sheet (tools/codex-image.mjs, $0) → assets-src/sprites/pipeline/build.mjs (crop + 64×64)

generations.tool: codex exec (Codex CLI built-in image generation)
generations.prompt:
TEXT-ONLY BRIEF (no reference images are attached): the look is the chunky pixel-texture look of the first-person weapon and the gloved hands of a modern retro first-person horde shooter set on a cold moonlit night (a dented brass fuel tank, blackened iron pipes, worn leather gloves): every material shaded with a few flat tones in crisp square pixel blocks, small clusters of darker pixels as wear, muted colours.

A TEXTURE SWATCH SHEET for a retro first-person game: exactly 6 square pixel-art material swatches arranged in 2 rows of 3 on a flat, perfectly uniform, solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, with wide magenta gaps between the swatches. Each swatch is a completely filled square of 64 x 64 art pixels (every art pixel a crisp square block, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur), flat and evenly lit (no perspective, no outline, no border, no text), seamless so it can tile:
Row 1: (1) worn dark-brown glove LEATHER with creases, scuffs and a stitched seam; (2) dented polished BRASS, warm yellow-brown with darker patina blotches, small dents and a riveted seam; (3) blackened IRON, cool dark grey with rivets, scratches and rust specks.
Row 2: (4) OAK WOOD grain, mid-brown planks with grain lines and a knot; (5) rough dark grey-green wool CLOTH for a sleeve, a coarse weave; (6) a scuffed red-brown leather STRAP texture with a stitched edge and a small iron buckle hole.

viewmodel/leather.png.postprocess: cropped from the swatch sheet, 64×64, then re-toned to a muted mean colour by VM_GRADE in assets-src/sprites/pipeline/build.mjs (since 2026-11-13; --vm-only re-grades without re-packing the atlas)
